## What does this contribute?

Describe the knowledge, skill, agent, integration, evaluation, or project update.

## Who uses it?

Identify the project, team, or expected audience.

## How was it verified?

List reviews, commands, examples, or evaluation cases used to check the contribution.

## Checklist

- [ ] I placed the contribution in the narrowest sensible location.
- [ ] I identified owners and sources where applicable.
- [ ] I checked links and commands.
- [ ] I did not include credentials or restricted information.
- [ ] I tested executable content or explained why it was not tested.
